verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API is versioned by URL path (/api/v1/) and its OpenAPI spec carries a version number (1.0.2). However, the evidence states there is no published deprecation policy or API changelog, and /changelog returns 404. So only the versioning half of the story is delivered, and only thinly. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a public API changelog, any documented version-lifecycle or sunset guarantees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: the API carries path versioning only (/api/v1, spec version 1.0.2)
Requests run against the live workspace (https://{subdomain}.fellow.app/api/v1/...)
